title: Design System: From Signal to Systems

governs: src/pages/[lang]/index.astro — the landing route and its first viewport
doesNotGovern: public/worlds/* — the cinematic Worlds keep their own art direction
src/components/Contact.astro — re-toned on this route only, through route-scoped overrides at the end of signal.css
scope.inheritsFrom: src/styles/tokens.css (font faces and the six-theme system). signal.css declares nothing on :root.

signal-accent.usage: The single accent. Marks only a real path: the travelled workflow route (stopping at the approval gate), the matched media clip, the focused control, the primary action fill, the selection highlight and the caret.

mass-shipped.note: MEASURED, not specified. index.ts asks for MeshBasicMaterial 0x080B12 (luminance 0.003346, lighter than the ground); the finish review measured rgb(0,1,2), darker than the ground. The blend or the scrim inverts it. #080B12 is not a shipped token.

scene-paperboard.usage: The carton. roughness .95, metalness 0, with a deterministic fibre roughness map.

display.purpose: The first viewport headline only. Two lines, at most 22ch; the second line drops to 74% ink mixed toward the ground.

display-ar.purpose: Al Rai Media, declared in tokens.css as --font-ar-display (weights 500-950). Arabic display resets letter-spacing to 0 and line-height to 1.24. Arabic body stays on Cairo Variable, which supplies the regular weight Al Rai Media lacks.

headline.purpose: The chapter heading. Nothing sits above it. 18ch cap in the still document.

headline-cinema.purpose: The same element inside the sticky stage, smaller and uncapped.

title.purpose: The project identity line. The proof figure shares its size in primary ink with tabular numerals.

body.purpose: The project summary, 56ch. 14px and uncapped inside the cinema.

body-limit.purpose: The boundary paragraph, 56ch. Its lead-in phrase sets 650 in primary ink INLINE, never above the heading.

label.purpose: Space Grotesk. The honesty caption naming what the dominant visual actually is. 11px below 560px.

label-status.purpose: Public / Private, uppercase over a hairline. Arabic drops the uppercasing and the tracking and rises to 12px.

shadows.name: plate-inflow
shadows.purpose: A plate in the still document.

shadows.name: plate-cinema
shadows.purpose: The handed-off capture over the rendered scene.

shadows.name: evidence-doubled-rule
shadows.purpose: NOT elevation. The media evidence kind's second rule, drawn with box-shadow because it is a line.

motion.name: scroll-is-the-clock
motion.purpose: Every frame is a pure evaluation of scroll progress. There is no animation queue and no entrance animation, so reverse scroll, restored scroll, deep links and Home/End reconstruct earlier states exactly.

motion.name: reading-stop-decay
motion.value: residual motion -> 0 at a reading stop
motion.purpose: The camera rests and ambient life decays to zero at each reading stop. That decay is what makes the stop readable.

motion.name: runway
motion.purpose: The scroll length the seven chapters are mapped onto.

motion.name: handoff-blend
motion.purpose: 0 while the 3D surface owns the pixels, 1 once the HTML capture does. The image is aligned to the projected rect first, so the handoff neither jumps nor double-renders.

motion.name: no-motion-path
motion.purpose: Animation and transition are cleared and the still composition stands. The cinema block never applies.

tiers.name: rule
tiers.note: Lower tiers keep the same story and the same major illusions. A smaller budget never substitutes static art.

fallbacks.result: the still composition (it is what the server ships; data-graphics is set only after a live frame)

fallbacks.note: All four land on the same document: seven chapters in document order with their real plates. It is a document worth reading, not a degraded page.

narrative.overview:
This world governs one thing: the landing route's first viewport and the seven-chapter cinematic segment that follows it. Everything in it is charcoal and silver until a real product capture enters the frame. The stage is dark in every one of the site's six themes, because the scene it frames is a night sky and a lit object — the stylesheet deliberately touches nothing on :root, so the theme system outside the stage survives untouched.

The density is low and the surfaces are few. There are two material families: the flat HTML layer (ground, reading scrims, hairlines, captures) and the rendered layer (graphite, satin, steel, paperboard, thin luminous edges). No glass, no rainbow nebula, no chrome. Depth is carried by tonal separation and one long soft drop under a capture; it is never carried by an outline that pretends to be light.

The system's governing idea is that a visual makes a claim, so the claim is labelled in type. Four evidence kinds render as rule weight and font weight — never as a coloured chip — and a chapter that names a project with no approved capture draws the absence as a broken rule rather than filling it with something that merely looks like proof.
keyCharacteristics: Near-monochrome ground with exactly one accent that only ever marks a real path.
Status carried in rule weight, dash and doubling; never in hue.
One registration datum at 42% that holds still across all seven chapters.
Every frame a pure function of scroll; no animation queue, no entrance motion.
The still document is the base layer, not the fallback.

rules.name: The Colour Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Colour arrives from real product screenshots, never from the environment. If a surface is not a capture, it is charcoal, silver or ink.

rules.name: The One Path Rule
rules.body: The accent marks one thing at a time and only a thing that is real: the travelled path, the matched clip, the focused control. It never invents a status, and a number never takes a hue to mean pass or fail.

rules.name: The Line Is The Heading Rule
rules.body: A chapter's narration line is the <h2>. No eyebrow, no kicker, no label sits above it. Qualifying words go inline inside the paragraph they qualify.

rules.name: The Arabic Is Not Tracked Latin Rule
rules.body: Arabic display swaps the face to Al Rai Media and resets letter-spacing to 0 and line-height to 1.24. Never ship Arabic display type on the Latin metrics.

rules.name: The Datum Holds Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats free. Every copy column, in-flow plate and chapter rule registers against --signal-datum, and the datum holds still for the whole segment.

rules.name: The Crop, Don't Shrink Rule
rules.body: The opening artifact and the chapter plate cross the frame edge rather than scaling down to fit inside it. A smaller viewport gets less of the artifact at full size, never all of it at toy size.

rules.name: The Falloff, Not The Box Rule
rules.body: The copy in the cinema sits on a gradient scrim that decays to fully transparent on the reading-direction side (and upward in portrait). A scrim with a visible edge makes the rectangle the loudest shape on screen; it must fall off, never terminate.

dos: Do let colour arrive only from a real product capture; keep every authored surface charcoal, silver or ink.
Do carry evidence status in rule weight, dash and doubling (2px solid / 1px hairline / 1px dashed / hairline plus doubled rule) so it never depends on telling two hues apart.
Do draw the absence: a chapter naming a project with no approved capture gets the unwoven rule and a sentence saying so.
Do register every column, plate and rule against --signal-datum (42% desktop, 0 portrait) and hold it still across all seven chapters.
Do make every frame a pure function of scroll progress, so reverse scroll, restored scroll, deep links and Home/End evaluate to exactly the same state.
Do let residual motion decay to zero at a reading stop; a reading stop that still drifts is not readable.

Do keep the same story at every tier — desktop 32000 morph points / 2200 stars at pixel ratio 1.5, phone 12000 / 900 at 1.25, light 6000 / 420 at 1.0 — rather than substituting static art for a smaller budget.
Do ship the still composition as the base layer: all seven chapters in document order with their real plates, which is what reduced motion, no WebGL, no JS and a lost context all land on.
Do swap the Arabic display face to Al Rai Media and reset its tracking to 0 and leading to 1.24.
Do crop the opening artifact and the plate past the frame edge instead of scaling them down.
Do keep colour scoped: this stylesheet touches nothing on :root, and its seam overrides apply to the landing route alone.
donts: Don't use hue to carry a status, a result or a quality judgement. The accent is not a success colour and secondary ink is not a warning.
Don't put an eyebrow, kicker or label above a narration line or a heading. Qualifiers go inline in the paragraph they qualify.
Don't use gradient-filled or shimmering text anywhere in this world; the close carries its weight in type.
Don't add a hard offset shadow or an ambient hover shadow; the only shadows are the three long soft drops above.
Don't give a scrim a visible edge. It falls off on every free side or it becomes the loudest rectangle on screen.
Don't add an entrance animation, a scroll-reveal or an animation queue to this segment. There is no queue; there is only scroll progress.
Don't render an evidence label as a coloured chip, pill or badge.
Don't let a plate become a full-bleed background behind the copy.
Don't move the datum per chapter, or let a plate or action float free of it.
Don't introduce glass, blur panels, rainbow nebulae, glyph-font icons or a system display face; icons are inline SVG and the display face is Inter Variable / Al Rai Media.

Don't extend these rules to the cinematic Worlds under public/worlds/, the 38 project story routes, or the shared Contact.astro component. They keep their own art direction; the landing route re-tones only the close, and only through route-scoped overrides.
notCanonized: The opening mass inverts: index.ts specifies MeshBasicMaterial 0x080B12 (luminance 0.003346, lighter than the #05070A ground at 0.002061), but the finish review measured it rendering at rgb(0,1,2) — darker than the ground. The measured value is recorded; #080B12 is not a shipped token and the inversion is not a rule.

The Email tile in the closing contact band still renders violet rgb(78,52,87) with an rgb(29,18,33) bloom; its wash is not driven by the --cf-* custom properties the route re-points, so the token override does not reach it. Leftover of the previous world, not a palette entry.
The opening mass and rim fall outside the frame at 390px, so the first viewport's thesis element currently reads on desktop only.
Limitation paragraphs clip on a line boundary at full contrast inside the cinema (max-height: calc(3 * 1.6em)), which can end mid-sentence with no affordance signalling that the sentence continues.

The close's kicker element survives as markup: the route neutralizes .cf-kicker's gradient fill and recolours it, but the eyebrow still renders above the closing heading. An eyebrow above a heading is banned by this system; this instance is a carried defect of the inherited component, not a pattern to copy.
